title: Out-of-Hours Doctor in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **The KV on-call practices open only on Friday 15:00 to 21:00 and on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays 9:00 to 21:00** (winter hours, 1 October to 31 March; until 20:00 from April).
**Monday to Thursday evening and every night after 21:00 no practice is open.** Then the door is **116117**, day and night: advice on the phone and a doctor's home visit if you are too ill to travel.

**Eleven practices:** six for adults (Westend, Friedrichshain, Gesundbrunnen, Marzahn, Buckow, Steglitz) and five for children (Westend, Lichtenberg, Wedding, Buckow, Tempelhof). The children's practice in Neukölln is **closed on Fridays**.
**112 is for emergencies:** chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, heavy bleeding, someone who will not wake up.
**Teeth are separate:** weekend dental duty 9:00 to 12:00 and 15:00 to 18:00, announced on **030 89004-333**, plus two night sites from 20:00 to 2:00.
**My move:** save 116117 and 112 today, and find your nearest adult and children's practice by postcode on the map in this post.
